title: You don't need a million pesos to start a church.
paragraphs:
You don't need a million pesos to start a church.
You need one thing most people have forgotten... Jesus Christ.

Some believers are waiting for the perfect building.
The perfect budget.
The perfect team.
The perfect timing.
Meanwhile...
People around them are dying without hearing the Gospel.
That's not how the New Testament Church began.

The early believers had no mega buildings.
No massive budgets.
No celebrity pastors.

They had Jesus.
They had God's Word.
They had the Holy Spirit.
And God changed the world.

How to Start a Church That Centers Jesus Christ
Step-by-Step with Zero Budget

This is a practical, Bible-centered guide for believers who feel God calling them to make disciples, plant a house church, start a Bible study, or build a Christ-centered community—without waiting for money or perfect circumstances.
Inside this powerful 75+ page guide, you'll discover:
✅ How to start a biblical church with little to no budget
✅ The New Testament blueprint for Christ-centered gatherings
✅ How to make disciples instead of simply attracting crowds
✅ How to lead with humility, integrity, and biblical conviction
✅ Common mistakes that cause churches to lose their focus on Christ
✅ Practical steps for worship, leadership, evangelism, and stewardship
✅ How ordinary believers can faithfully answer God's call today
🔥 Most People vs. Few People
Most people wait until everything is perfect.
Few people obey God with what they already have.
Most people dream about changing the world.
Few people faithfully disciple one person at a time.
Most people build ministries around personalities.
Few people build everything around Jesus Christ.
Which one will you become?
